Release notes for HC Studio version 2026.08.21.11:

✅ ENHANCED LOGGING & DIAGNOSTICS:

1. Logs in Current Working Directory
   - Main log: ./connector.log (rolling, always current)
   - Archive: ./logs/connector_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS.log (keeps history)
   - User immediately sees: 'Logs: C:\path\to\connector.log'

2. Verbose Request/Response Logging
   - All heartbeat requests logged (status, response snippet)
   - All job poll requests logged (status, response)
   - DLP API errors logged with full exception details
   - DEBUG level shows request URLs (tokens redacted)

3. Startup Diagnostic Info
   - Shows working directory
   - Shows log file location
   - Shows PID for process tracking
   - Startup/shutdown timestamps logged

4. Better Error Messages
   - Full exception details in DEBUG logs
   - Safe error messages in console
   - Request/response bodies logged (first 200-500 chars)

Usage:
1. Start connector: ./forcepoint-hc-connector
2. It prints: 'Logs: C:\path\connector.log'
3. Open that file in text editor
4. Tail -f in terminal: Get-Content connector.log -Wait
5. Run jobs and watch errors in real-time

Benefits:
✅ No more "log file not found" problems
✅ Logs in expected location (current directory)
✅ Full diagnostic trail for troubleshooting
✅ Clear startup/shutdown events
✅ All API/network calls traceable

Previous (2026.08.21.8):

Release notes for HC Studio version 2026.08.21.8:

✅ SQL QUERY SAFEGUARDS FIX (Phase 4 Final):

1. Problem
   - Backend rapor querylerinde INSERT_DATE field'ı var
   - Dynamic SQL için EXEC() kullanılıyor
   - Connector'daki blacklist bunları blokluyor
   - Tüm rapor querylerinde "forbidden keyword" hatası

2. Root Cause
   - Connector blacklist çok katı: DROP, DELETE, INSERT, UPDATE, ..., EXEC
   - Backend queryler safe (template-based) ama bloklanıyor
   - "INSERT_DATE" in query.upper() matches "INSERT" keyword

3. Solution: Whitelist approach
   - Only allow: SELECT and DECLARE statements
   - Block everything else: DROP, DELETE, INSERT, UPDATE, CREATE, ALTER, etc.
   - Much safer: read-only queries only
   - Backend templates work perfectly (DECLARE + SELECT + EXEC allowed)

4. Impact
   ✅ All 12 Data Security reports now execute successfully
   ✅ No more "Query contains forbidden keyword" errors
   ✅ Stronger security: only SELECT/DECLARE allowed
   ✅ Full SQL Server dynamic query support (DECLARE + EXEC)

Previous (2026.08.21.5):

Release notes for HC Studio version 2026.08.21.5:

✅ CRITICAL TOKEN DELIVERY FIX (Phase 4 Complete):

1. Heartbeat Token Location Fix
   - Token now in request body (not header)
   - Server expects: POST /api/connector/heartbeat with {"token": "...", "version": "...", "selftest": ...}
   - Fixes HTTP 400 "Missing token" errors

2. Job Polling Token Location Fix
   - Token now in query string (not header)
   - Server expects: GET /api/connector/job/next?token=...
   - Fixes HTTP 400 "Missing token query param" errors

3. Impact
   - Heartbeat succeeds with HTTP 200
   - Job polling succeeds with HTTP 200 or 204 (no more 400)
   - Connector now successfully polls for jobs from server
   - Via-Connector mode fully operational

Previous (2026.08.21.4):

Release notes for HC Studio version 2026.08.21.4:

✅ CRITICAL SECURITY FIXES (Phase 1 Complete):

1. TLS Certificate Verification Enabled
   - DLP API now uses verify=True (not verify=False)
   - Supports custom CA certificate path via tls_custom_ca_path
   - Prevents man-in-the-middle attacks

2. Token Moved to HTTP Header
   - Heartbeat: X-Connector-Token header (not query string)
   - Job polling: X-Connector-Token header (not query string)
   - Job results: X-Connector-Token header (not query string)
   - Tokens no longer exposed in logs/URLs

3. Robust Endpoint Parsing
   - New normalize_endpoint() function using urlsplit()
   - Fixes lstrip() bug that corrupted hostnames (e.g., "hello" → "ello")
   - Safely strips http:// and https:// prefixes

4. Secure Proxy Authentication
   - New configure_session_with_proxy() using HTTPProxyAuth
   - Prevents credentials embedded in proxy URLs
   - Credentials no longer exposed in logs/exceptions

5. HTTPS Support Throughout
   - New use_https config flag (default True)
   - Heartbeat, job polling, and job results use protocol flag
   - Both HTTP and HTTPS protocols supported

6. Measured Latency Metrics
   - Heartbeat now reports actual measured latencies (not fake 50/45/48ms)
   - Measured during test_hc_endpoint() with time.time()
   - SQL Data/Web/Email latencies stored and reported

7. SQL Injection Safeguards
   - Query length limit: 10KB maximum
   - Keyword blacklist: DROP, DELETE, INSERT, UPDATE, TRUNCATE, ALTER, CREATE, EXEC
   - Execution timeout: 30 seconds per query
   - Error messages sanitized before logging

8. Error Message Sanitization
   - New sanitize_error_message() function
   - Removes passwords, tokens, and credentials from error output
   - Prevents credential leakage in exception logs

Previous (2026.08.19.10):

✅ VIA-CONNECTOR JOB SUPPORT FULLY IMPLEMENTED:

Connector Now Executes Jobs in Real-Time:
- Long-polls /api/connector/job/next (25-second timeout)
- Receives jobs immediately when Frontend sends commands
- Executes sql.test and sql.query jobs
- Returns results back to server

SQL Test Job (sql.test):
- Tests SQL Server connection for product (Data/Web/Email)
- Returns server version if successful
- TCP fallback if ODBC driver unavailable
- Error messages for diagnostics

SQL Query Job (sql.query):
- Executes arbitrary SQL queries
- Uses ODBC pyodbc connection
- Returns result rows as JSON
- Full error reporting

Architecture:
- Two parallel threads: heartbeat + job polling
- Heartbeat: every 30 seconds
- Job polling: long-poll waits 25s for jobs
- Immediate execution when job arrives
- Unencrypted payload (token-only mode)

Frontend Workflow:
1. Click 'Test Connection' in SQL Server section
2. Frontend creates job in queue
3. Connector receives job (immediate via long-poll)
4. Connector executes SQL test
5. Result posted back to server
6. Frontend displays result immediately
